liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack Straw** (3 reviews, 1 other source): Jerry's playing on Jack Straw stands out, giving the listener a shiver; Jack Straw is a powerful, hard-hitting version, notable given that 1980 isn't known for powerhouse versions [4][11][12][19]
- **Cold Rain and Snow** (1 review): Cold Rain and Snow into Looks Like Rain is outstanding [17]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): The Scarlet Begonias into Fire On the Mountain is called the main reason to get the show [16]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): The end of Fire On the Mountain reaches unreal heights [16]
- **C.C. Rider** (1 review): C.C. Rider is wild, with Bobby sounding delirious; the end of Scarlet>Fire is also hot [20]
- **Eyes of the World** (1 review): In Eyes, around the seven-minute mark before 'sometimes we live', Jerry keeps pushing instead of winding down [20]

## Setlist highlights

- **More Space**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 4 archived performances [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-08-30.sbd.munder.tetzeli.fix-8875-15408.34939.reflac.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 175 min; rated 4.4/5 by 5 [1]
- **gd1980-08-30.175069.sbd.miller.phase-repair.flac1644**: soundboard; 22 songs; 173 min [4]
- **gd80-08-30.wise.vernon.16039.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 178 min; rated 2/5 by 5 [5]. Said about its sound: This audience recording's sound quality is poor and doesn't do the show justice; Reviewer suggests seeking out the soundboard or a better audience tape instead of this one; Recording is poor; reviewer says better tapes of this show exist and claims to own one [11][12][13]
- **gd80-08-30.set2-sbd.munder.8775.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 14 songs; 104 min; rated 4.44/5 by 15 [8]. Said about its sound: Excellent-sounding soundboard; Brent is understated but effective and Phil is felt throughout; Sound quality is excellent, with especially good channel separation [14][20]
- **gd80-08-30.set1-sbd.munder.15408.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 10 songs; 71 min; rated 3/5 by 5 [10]. Said about its sound: Excellent-sounding soundboard; Brent is understated but effective and Phil is felt throughout; Soundboard is a couple of generations from perfect but very listenable, not horrible [15][17]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended; it was hot in the venue, especially during the first set [13]
- Reviewer, who was there, recalls the band as mellow and relaxed [14]
- Reviewer, who was there, recalls the band as mellow and relaxed [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-08-30.sbd.munder.tetzeli.fix-8875-15408.34939.reflac.flac16**: transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: SHNID 15408 and SHNID 8875 [1]. Also: Fix of shnid 8775 with shnid 15408 added at the start, combining two sources into the complete show; Overlap between CDs 2 and 3 had fades; splice was matched by guesswork, and overlapping fade tracks were added for CD burning [1]
- **gd1980-08-30.175069.sbd.miller.phase-repair.flac1644**: transferred by All Mastering by Charlie Miller  November 6, 2025; source: Set 1: SBD > Cassette Master > ? > CD Set 2: SBD > Cassette Master > Sonic Solutions > DAT > CD [4]. Also: Vocal phase issue repaired on shnid 110152, with pitch correction settings from Joe B. Jones [4]
- **gd80-08-30.wise.vernon.16039.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Jim Wise; source: Audience Recording: Sennheiser 421's [5]
- **gd80-08-30.set2-sbd.munder.8775.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [8]
- **gd80-08-30.set1-sbd.munder.15408.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [10]
